steps.note: K1.a.1 states that rows 0-1 remove the old scratch contribution, rows 2-5 add the source effect, rows 6-7 restore the scratch, so the net target change is (JV+RG)x independent of the initial scratch vectors a,c.
K1.a.2 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2, side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, intersection zero/two already zero, self coefficient one.
K1.a.3 gives the complex central coefficient (|S∩T|-1)/2, side wires cancelling intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero, self coefficient one.
K1.b states the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) with each invocation restoring its own auxiliary wires; K1's method also names forward, inverse, forward invocations.

The plan never lists the per-edge orthogonal residuals and their dimensions (no table entries such as (a-1)(h-1), h-1, h, a-1, ah(f-1)); K3.B.2 only states the generic rank of P_V-P_U and S3.1.b assumes an edge residual basis.
No step mentions the side edge 2->5, the neighbor relation t_X ⊥ t_Y, or the complement <t_X,t_Y>^⊥ of dimension h-2.

K3.A.2 says the only decreasing edges are the central-wire edges from time 3 to 4 each losing h (L=Ich); K3.A.1 and the K3.A method/motivation give telescoping at gates, sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N, absolute Wm-2N+2L.
The plan only assumes an orthonormal basis of each edge residual (S3.1 method, S3.1.b); it never gives the nondegenerate/nonalternating argument or the absorption of alternating planes.
K3.A.3 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2.
No step states that binary weight is additive mod 4 on orthogonal vectors or that q_V-q_U = sum of wt(v)[v.x] over an orthonormal basis; S3.1.b just asserts the translation-kernel product.

The plan asserts the frame change is a product of kernels aI+bX_v (S3.1 method, S3.1.b) and gives C=aI+bX (S3.1.a) but never says wt(v) is odd, gives the phase i^{eps[v.x]}, or uses H diag(1,-1) H = X to turn it into a translation kernel.

S3.1.b gives one directional kernel per residual vector, S3.1.d gives s_c child calls each on the f axes (columns) of one slot, and S3.3.a one recursive call on a slot per residual-basis vector, so s_c factors in all; the tensor-power identity itself is not written out.

The plan names 'source and sink corrections' (S3.1.e) but never states zero label frame I, full label C^{⊗m}, C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a), the Z_{a,k} / i^{27k}Z_{a,k} repair, or negation of the X outputs; S3.1.c's (C^{-1})^{⊗f} identity concerns edge kernels, not the endpoint pair.
K3.A.3/K3.A state L<N/2 (ratios 100/539, 101/539 below 1/2) and K3.B.4 derives deficit N-2L_b>0 hence s_b<W_b m.
The value eta_b = 339/22587335000000 does not appear anywhere in the plan.
The value eta_c = 73/19906842167500 does not appear anywhere in the plan.
K3.C states the deficit exceeds 20*2^-50 and log m<20, so m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50)>m(1-eta) and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^-50 (sigma=tau stated in S6.1.a).

K4 states only the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones (quoting the lemma statement at line 1366) and gives no elimination proof (no topmost-row/rightmost-entry pivot, clearing, or repetition on active indices).
No step mentions choosing a fixed odd prime avoiding denominators of a finite table of factors so the identities specialize to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.
K5.a states a lower triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order, multiplying by the diagonal unit and adding a combination of earlier coordinates.
K5.c gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j for each one of Pi, one interchange per one and a interchanges in all.
The plan gives E, B, nu and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) (S3.4.a-c) and C_1=20 (S6.1.a) but never defines C_0=128mB^2 or C_1=max{20,nu+3} nor nu=11, so the constants are only partly stated.
S3.4.a states A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at an internal node and A(e)<=8e at a leaf with E=64(W+m+1)^3, noting depth concatenates the s calls rather than dividing by W.

S3.4.b gives A(e)<=8dB^{k+1}<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} but not the unrolling (k<=ceil(log_m d), B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu) and nowhere shows the total depth stays below C_0 d^{C_1}, which is the third part of the sub-step.

S3.4.c states depth-l values lie in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^l and that p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits represent all intermediates exactly; S3.4.d gives eps*C_1<1 hence Delta=o(p).
S3.6 states every row of H has absolute row sum one so disks are preserved and truncation changes each component by less than 2^-p; S3.5 gives the resulting error below sqrt2*2^-p.

summary: P11 carries the bank-exchange network fully (B1-B4), the loss-budget totals and ratios (L3, L5), the phase-network child count (P3), the rank-saving inequality and exponent step (R1, R4), the shear cost steps (M3, M4), and the depth recurrence, bit-width and disk-truncation steps (S2, S4, S5). It omits the residual table and side-edge argument (L1, L2), the nonalternating/orthonormal-basis argument (L4), the weight-mod-4 and odd-weight kernel derivation (P1, P2), the endpoint repair (P4), the explicit eta values (R2, R3), the elimination proof and prime choice (M1, M2), and the full constant definitions and total-depth unrolling (S1, S3). 14 of 26 present.
